tasks.title: Conversation #123
tasks.transcript:
Man: Hey, Lisa, have you had a chance to visit that new cafe that just opened on 10 Street?
Woman: Not yet. I've heard mixed reviews. Some say it's fantastic, others not so much. Have you been?
Man: Yes. And I was pleasantly surprised. The ambiance is cozy and their espresso is probably the best I've had in town. The most disappointing part was their pastries, though maybe it was too late in the day.
Woman: Even so, it does sound worth trying. I'll swing by this weekend after my basketball game.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply about a café?

options.D: Visitors have mixed opinions about it.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：女士关于一家咖啡馆暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Not yet. I‘ve heard mixed reviews. Some say it's fantastic, others not so much. 选项分析： A. It should feature live music. 它应该有现场音乐。对话中未提及音乐，所以A选项错误。 B. It’s not very big. 它不太大。对话中未提及咖啡馆的大小，所以B选项错误。 C. Employees there need more training. 那里的员工需要更多培训。对话中未提及员工培训，所以C选项错误。 D. Visitors have mixed opinions about it. 访客对它有褒贬不一的看法。女士明确说听到了“mixed reviews”（褒贬不一的评价），所以D选项正确。

questions.stem: What disappointed the man about a café?

options.B: Some baked items were not fresh.

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：男士对咖啡馆的什么感到失望？ 定位原文：Man: The most disappointing part was their pastries, though maybe it was too late in the day. 选项分析： A. It was too busy. 它太忙了/人太多。对话中未提及客流量，所以A选项错误。 B. Some baked items were not fresh. 一些烘焙食品不新鲜。男士说最失望的是他们的糕点（pastries），并推测可能因为当天太晚了（不够新鲜），所以B选项正确。 C. Its coffee was expensive. 它的咖啡很贵。对话中未提及价格，男士反而说咖啡是城里最好的，所以C选项错误。 D. Its location is inconvenient. 它的位置不方便。对话中未提及位置便利性，所以D选项错误。
